title: Sharing my AI gamedev adventure
author: EdgeMaster8904

comments.author: ratzla77
comments.body:
Neat! I'm doing something quasi similar with my game. I've got assets and a bit more of a cozy feel in unity. 

How long did you take to bring it from empty project to this trailer?

replies.author: EdgeMaster8904
replies.body:
Ey!
Good luck on yours. Do share the link once its up on Steam!

Mine took 3 days, iterating with Claude from 8am until 2am each day. It was the timelimit I set for myself as it was the only offtime I would have in a long time.

Ps: the trailer and all the posters were all done by claude as well.

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: When I see people post stuff like this, I am left legitimately wondering if the people behind them even play games.

replies.author: EdgeMaster8904
replies.body:
Hey! I would be the people. Mind sharing what your issue is with what you see?

Yes I do play games. Unfortunately not as often as I used to nor want to. Abit confined to short games that doesnt take too much time due to work 

That said, more then understand, how sometimes when we go into development, we tunnel vision so much that while u understand and love what I have made, it might have been made playable only because I have spent so much time thinking of it. To anyone and everyone else, its as per what you are saying, what even is this.

So yes, please share, more then happy to learn
